useCases.name: No Identity & Address Proof Verification
useCases.desc: Communication to be sent to users who haven't completed KYC yet
useCases.pre:
Trigger event / segment will be provided by the client team.
JS/SDK integration needs to be done along with the event integration.
Email, App Push & WhatsApp templates/creatives to be shared by client team so it can be configured on the journeys.
DNS configuration for Emails to be completed by the client team.
WhatsApp Configuration to be completed by Netcore team
Entire journey is listed on this link : https://whimsical.com/dealing-onboarding-journey-QRGXT5mFHHFFraLyxbBaQ7
